  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),

  CONSTRAINT chk_items_quantity_nonnegative CHECK (quantity >= 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;

SQL
